annotations.title: Get prediction market odds (Kalshi, Polymarket, Manifold, PredictIt)

description: Prediction markets from Kalshi, Polymarket, Manifold and PredictIt in one table: the market-implied probability, every outcome price, bid and ask, 24-hour and 7-day change, volume, liquidity, open interest, close date, status and, once settled, the result. Search by keyword or category, or pass market links or tickers; optional daily price history. Use for event forecasting, news context and research. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/prediction-markets on your Apify account (about $0.003 per market; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

closes_within_days.description: Only markets that close within this many days.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

history_days.description: Add a daily price history of this many days (Kalshi and Polymarket). 0 = none.

markets.description: Market or event links, Kalshi tickers or Polymarket slugs.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

min_volume_24h.description: Minimum 24-hour volume (dollars on Polymarket, contracts on Kalshi).

search.description: Keywords, e.g. "fed rate", "bitcoin", "election". Empty = the busiest markets.

status.description: open, closed (settled, with result) or all.

name: get_prediction_markets

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get prediction market odds (Kalshi, Polymarket, Manifold, PredictIt)
